targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at,'1h') AS time, COUNT(*) AS value FROM trip WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM trip WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at);
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM trip WHERE estado='finalizado' AND $__timeFilter(finished_at);
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(precio_eur),0),2) AS value FROM trip WHERE estado='finalizado' AND $__timeFilter(finished_at);

SELECT d.id_driver AS driver_id, u.nombre AS driver_name, COUNT(*) AS offers_total, SUM(o.estado='aceptada') AS offers_accepted, ROUND(100*SUM(o.estado='aceptada')/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),2) AS acceptance_pct FROM offer o JOIN driver d ON d.id_driver=o.id_driver JOIN user u ON u.id_user=d.id_driver WHERE $__timeFilter(o.created_at) GROUP BY d.id_driver, u.nombre ORDER BY acceptance_pct DESC, offers_total DESC;

SELECT c.id_company, c.nombre AS company, ROUND(SUM(t.precio_eur),2) AS revenue_eur, ROUND(SUM(t.precio_eur)/NULLIF(SUM(t.distancia_km),0),3) AS eur_per_km, ROUND(SUM(t.precio_eur)/NULLIF(SUM(t.duracion_min),0),3) AS eur_per_min FROM trip t JOIN driver d ON d.id_driver=t.id_driver JOIN company c ON c.id_company=d.id_company WHERE t.estado='finalizado' AND $__timeFilter(t.finished_at) GROUP BY c.id_company, c.nombre ORDER BY revenue_eur DESC;
